Professor Jiang makes a bold claim on the Danny Jones podcast: a secret family, he says, quietly controls leaders like Donald Trump and Benjamin Netanyahu. The episode title quotes his charge directly. Jones, who hosts long talks on power and hidden history, gives the theory a full hearing.

Jiang lays out who he believes this family is and how their influence is meant to work. He connects money, media, and war into one hidden-hand story. Jones presses him on names, proof, and where the chain of control breaks. Questioning listeners get a sweeping conspiracy claim stated plainly, to weigh for themselves.
